title: Fletcher Henderson charts help launch the Shaw band
summary: Hinton asks who Fletcher Henderson was; Leeman says Henderson's arrangements, also behind Goodman's band, helped start Shaw's orchestra.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Now let's let people know who
Fletcher Henderson was.
Well, he was a great band leader in his time, and a great arranger.
And he had a band.
Oh yes. The nucleus of his arrangements were done to form the Benny Goodman orchestra.
Later.
Yes.
At this time, he hadn't formed the Benny Goodman orchestra though.
Oh, yes. Benny Goodman was in production then.
Then he had a band of his own.
I see.
So he brought in to help Artie, who was a friend of his -- and that's how we got started with the Artie Shaw orchestra.
Oh, Benny Goodman was already established.
Yes. Benny was on his way with the Let's Dance Show.
And hadn't you made some arrangements for him already?
Yes.
'Stealin' Apples' and all that stuff
he/ you did for Benny Goodman?
Right, yes.
I see. Well, this is important that we know.
That was the formation of the Artie Shaw orchestra, and then we went to Boston.
